We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions for private banking CRM, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Advanced skills in Power Apps, Dataverse, plugin development, Azure administration, and ETL processes.
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, DevOps, and reusable solution frameworks.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading teams of 30+ members.

Job Description

Global Banking & Markets, Operations – China Local Markets, Analyst/ Associate, Shenzhen

GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS

Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team with a passion for the markets, with individuals who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor.

OPERATIONS

Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted division that partners with all areas of the firm to deliver banking, sales and trading, and asset management capabilities to clients around the world. Alongside this vital service delivery role, Operations provides essential risk management and control, preserving and enhancing the firm’s assets and its reputation.

The Futures Operations team supports the clearing and settlement of futures and options contracts in China markets, the primary daily responsibilities include processing, validating and settling futures transactions. The team has extensive interaction with internal and external parties to ensure effective oversight for existing business but also to shape and implement solutions for new products, strategies and systems.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual, who is a team player. This person needs to multi-task well, have excellent client service skills and possess good organizational skills and be able to adapt quickly to an ever-changing list of issues. Additionally, the role will require extensive coordination and communication with various operations teams and professionals across the firm.

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential

  • Working with a team of Operations professionals in providing critical front to back trading support
  • Identify gaps in processing and make recommendations to close those gaps
  • Establish relationships with brokers, custodians and vendors to streamline workflow wherever possible
  • Lead projects, e.g. new business designs, architecture transformation and process automation, etc.
  • Act as escalation point to senior Operations managers for issue resolution
  • Conduit to business stakeholders in influencing decision making

Skills & Experience We’re Looking For

  • Attention to detail and good follow up skills
  • Demonstrate leadership and ownership of issue resolution
  • Self-motivated and driven to achieve
  • Analytical in identifying solutions to problems
  • Ability to manage pressure and prioritize multiple tasks daily
  • Team-player, excellent communication skills
  • Excellent spoken and written English and Mandarin

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1-6 years of experience working in Operations from China ons hore futures bro kers
  • Understanding of local regulatory and market practice
  • China Futures Association qualified

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Head of Insurance Bus Tech Solutioning .

Business: Insurance

Job ID ： 29976

Principal Responsibilities

 Strategic Innovation and Value Creation

  • Lead Innovation with Purpose. Imagine, shape, and deliver innovative business and technology solutions that solve real problems and deliver measurable impact. Champion a forward-thinking roadmap that turns vision into value
  • Develop and maintain a multi-year insurance business technology roadmap focused on AI, automation, and next-gen platforms.
  • Identify and evaluate new technologies and vendors that can create competitive advantage.
  • Facilitate strategic innovation workshops and prototype solutions with business teams.

Technology and Solution Leadership

  • Architect the Future. Own the design and development of scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions. You’ll steer the integration of AI, automation, and modern platforms that streamline processes and enhance decision-making across the enterprise.
  • Oversee the design, development, and implementation of scalable and sustainable business technology solutions.
  • Champion the application of AI and automation to streamline operations, reduce costs, and enhance decision-making.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure that solutions meet both technical and business requirements.
  • Jointly provide architectural and engineering direction across systems and platforms, ensuring technical excellence and alignment with business goals.
  • Design and develop optimal/future-proof solutions whilst providing reliable cost and effort estimations to solve complex and ambiguous problems using modern set of technology platforms, delivery disciplines and DevOps mindset
  • Deliver against a strategic operating plan (such as Core Capabilities) that ensures resources (capability, people and funding) deliver improvements in current customer journeys and new features to increase customer experience
  • Jointly manage the annual budget spread between designing and developing new services (Change The Bank) as well as managing and supporting existing services (Run the Bank)

Business Alignment and Collaboration

  • Collaborate across the various business functions. Be the go-to partner for our actuarial, underwriting, claims, and policy operations teams. Speak both “tech” and “insurance,” aligning everyone around solutions that work.
  • Partner with functional leaders across underwriting, claims, actuarial, policy administration, and operations.
  • Translate business goals into technology capabilities and work with teams to co-create solutions.
  • Develop strong internal networks to gain buy-in and drive adoption of new technologies and AI.
  • Improve technology solutioning and estimation for delivery (ie increase quality and innovation, be cost effective and improve resilience – design-to-operate)
  • Manage an effective working relationship with partners and third party vendors to ensure successful delivery and efficient cost management
  • Create and maintain strong and trusted working relationship outside of Insurance business in other IWPB business lines and the broader HSBC group
  • Represent Insurance in IWPB channel and digital for all technology and business executive forums

Leadership and Execution Oversight

  • Deliver real change. Translate strategic ideas into actionable technology initiatives that transform operations, customer journeys, and market performance. Lead cross-functional delivery with clarity, energy, and accountability.
  • Build trust and credibility. Influence senior executives, engage diverse stakeholders, and lead with transparency and confidence. Your leadership will inspire high-performing teams and nurture a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead and develop a high performing global insurance solutioning team through effective communication, performance management, development plans and reward/recognition practices.
  • Build a pipeline of solutioning, architecture and engineering talent
  • Cultivate an environment that supports diversity and reflects the HSBC brand and values

Operational Effectiveness and Control

  • Ensure technology goals are identified and aligned, communicated, documented and delivered in the most effective manner (cost, timeframe and resiliency) possible through to the completion of the successful deployment
  • Work closely with the Head of Platform Engineering to ensure solution and platform design are practical, scalable and future-proof whilst embedding the necessary risk controls and quality automation checks.
  • Consistent identification of key risks, issues and interdependencies and provide appropriate mitigation strategies
  • Ensure HSBC is not put at any operational or reputational risk

Major Challenges

The following are an overview of the major challenges for the role holder:

  • To manage effectively and be a key influencer in a matrix organization across diverse stakeholders and geographies
  • To deliver a set of globally integrated technology services supporting a diverse set of business and functional needs (as part of global Core Capabilities)
  • To connect teams across IWPB’s language, geographical/time zone, cultural, systems and legislative boundaries
  • To build new capabilities and change the status-quo for architecture and engineering with team members who have been in the organisation for a very long time (ie reluctance for change and cross skilling and adopting new tech)
  • To deal with a range of complex issues with conflicting and changing priorities
  • To manage the balance between effective execution of day-to-day operations and services, whilst driving a substantial transformation agenda, overall cost reduction and technology automation in a legacy technology landscape
  • To achieve the above whilst effectively ensuring that risk is well managed
  • To stay abreast of external developments in global regulation, market trends and competitor activity
  • To challenge the status quo with peers across Technology leadership teams, as well as counterparts in GBGFs
  • To capture, leverage and promote best practice methodologies and tools across IWPB, based on lessons learned across IWPB teams globally and on standards established by Global Tech horizontals (e.g. Design and Application Development & Maintenance, Tech Security, Tech Risk, Tech COO)

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

 Mandatory:

  • Outstanding Technology leader who is passionate about leveraging technology and AI to drive business outcomes
  • Significant years in cross-business technology leadership roles with a focus on business transformation within life insurance, with working
  • Deep understanding of insurance products, distribution, policy administration, claims processing, and regulatory factors in order to provide fit-for-purpose technology/AI solutions which drive sustainable business outcomes
  • Strong background in enterprise architecture, cloud platforms, and digital ecosystems relevant to Life Insurance in Asia (specifically HK, China and Singapore)
  • Proven track record of modernizing legacy systems and delivering new digital capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of operational effectiveness
  • Strong ability to balance risks vs. rewards and maximizing the cost effectiveness and profitability for the business
  • Possess the following competencies - strong people leadership, teamwork, is data and facts driven, sound judgment and decision making, effective communication skills
  • Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, and execution capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working with C-suite executives and presenting to boards or executive committees.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with AI, machine learning, automation (e.g., RPA), and API-based system integration would be highly desirable.
  • Experienced in managing programs, projects and a variety of delivery / assurance roles across a number of markets/locations and cultures
  • Built and manage commercially viable digital platforms, services and capabilities
  • Worked in the functional business areas in Life Insurance in Asia
  • An MBA or additional Life Insurance business qualifications are a plus.
  • Experienced at managing operational functions and leading process reengineering and efficiency exercises

Key Attributes

  • Innovative: Passionate about using technology to drive business transformation.
  • Credible Leader: Commands respect through knowledge, experience, and collaborative leadership.
  • Business-Savvy: Understands the intricacies of the life insurance business and how to deliver technology that matters.
  • Agile and Results-Oriented: Operates with urgency and adaptability, delivering tangible outcomes.
  • Change Agent: Energizes teams and stakeholders around a shared vision for the future.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Act as a focal point between frontline and OPS to submit mortgage application and drawdown requests.
  • Serve as a gatekeeper for mortgage documentation quality control through screening the mortgage application packages before submission for approval.
  • Contribute to the improvement of mortgage sales quality, streamlined mortgage process and cost effectiveness of mortgage business.
  • Track and monitor the application and drawdown process of each case.
  • Drive mortgage business growth by achieving needs fulfilled minimum standard and upholding document quality standard.
  • Monitor the progress of each pending case to ensure the achievement of monthly "needs fulfilled" minimum standards.
  • Proactively communicate with the Frontline and UWS/SD teams to ensure mortgage document quality and service excellence.
  • Stay alert to internal and external mortgage policies and market movements.
  • Contribute to IWPB and other related business services, such as account opening, mortgage after-sales services, and WEM sales referrals.
  • Support the Mortgage Sales team in collecting necessary documents and preparing proposals for new EBF projects.
  • Assist the Manager in managing and monitoring mortgage acquisition channel development, EBF utilization, the new acquisition pipeline, daily team activities, and the achievement of mortgage sales targets.
  • Support the Mortgage Sales team in arranging sales activities.

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Knowledge & Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least six months of experience in HSBC WPB roles.
  • Strong communication, client-focused, and influencing skills.
  • Sound knowledge of HSBC products and services, with a specific emphasis on digital channels.
  • High potential to transition into a sales role within six months.
  • Results-driven with the ability to work effectively under pressure.
  • Comprehensive understanding of local regulatory and licensing requirements.
  • Clear understanding of how to collaborate with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment.
  • Proficiency in English and local languages.
  • In-depth knowledge of mortgage products, credit policies, regulatory policies, and business systems.
  • Ability to establish and maintain a smooth communication and interaction platform between Operations (OPS) and the Frontline.
  • Commitment to supporting the monitoring of HML performance and processes.
  • Accountability for maintaining expert knowledge of HML products, credit policies, and business systems to ensure operational excellence.
  • Accreditations
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by the local market.
  • Meet all internal standards and requirements as mandated by HBCN.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment.   • Special initiatives: Lead strategic initiatives and analyses on behalf of the Director of IDP where dedicated focus is required, from framing the problem through to a decision-ready recommendation and implementation.

  • Lead the Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream through matrix leadership of contributors across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, without direct line authority.
  • Bring cohesion to the IDP China leadership team – connecting agendas, surfacing tensions early, and holding colleagues to the commitments they have made

Requirements

  • Programme management: Proven track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes or workstreams in a large organisation – planning, dependency and risk management, governance, and reporting into senior programme structures.
  • Strategic analysis: Ability to structure ambiguous problems, conduct rigorous analysis, and develop clear, decision-ready recommendations for a senior audience.
  • Executive communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with demonstrable experience producing materials for executive and Board-level audiences.

Job Summary

An Engineer –Test Automation is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts and frameworks to ensure the quality and reliability of software Roles and Responsibilities products. They conduct risk-based independent reviews of the Group ICS control efficacy, material attestation oversight (SWIFT), control testing oversight, and manage issues raised in assurance activities.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of test automation strategies aligned with business goals and software development processes. This involves selecting appropriate testing tools, frameworks, and methodologies to ensure efficient and effective test coverage

Business

  • Understanding software requirements and translating them into test cases and automation scripts
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to define acceptance criteria and quality standards for software products and features

Process

  • Designing and implementing automated testing processes and workflows to accelerate testing cycles and improve software quality. This includes developing automated test scripts, configuring test environments, and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and deployment
  • Operational management of iTrack/M7 platform (inc. system changes, onboarding of new users, information sources, reporting and data quality governance)
  • Conducting risk-based independent reviews of the Group ICS control efficacy in 1LoD and CISRO, using the Second Line Assurance Methodology
  • Reviewing control library and 1LoD control testing, including associated artefacts. People & Talent
  • Overseeing, challenging, and reviewing / assuring material attestations, particularly SWIFT, ensuring that Bank responses are evidence-based
  • Assuring 1LoD control testing approach
  • Overseeing control testing by 1LoD to assure risk reduction
  • Identifying and managing control gaps effectively during 1LoD control testing
  • Full issue lifecycle management to closure, for findings identified in reviews (inc. Assurance Reviews, Red Team Exercises, Control Testing, Regulatory findings and COSMOS findings)
  • Reviews and edits AI-generated test cases, creates additional manual and automated tests where needed, and ensures quality and compliance of solutions built

People & Talent

  • Building and nurturing a skilled test automation team capable of developing and maintaining automated test suites
  • Providing training, mentorship, and support to enhance team members' expertise in test automation tools, techniques, and best practices

Risk Management

  • Identifying and mitigating risks associated with software defects and quality issues
  • Implementing automated regression tests, performance tests, and security tests to detect and prevent defects early in the development lifecycle and minimize the risk of production failures

Governance

  • Establishing and enforcing governance frameworks to ensure consistency and compliance in test automation practices. This involves defining standards, guidelines, and processes for test case management, version control, and reporting to maintain transparency and accountability in testing activities

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

  • Scripting Language
  • Database Development
  • Information Security Management
  • Operating Systems
  • Network Infrastructure Security
  • Prompt Engineering
  • Contextual Design
  • AI Testing
  • API testing
  • Banking domain
  • Critical Thinking
  • Systems Design
  • AI Augmented Workflow Design

Other Skills

  • DevOps
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • System Testing
  • CI/CD
  • Web Application Security
  • Web Testing
  • Mobile Testing
  • Performance Testing

Qualifications

  • Languages: Business English

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business: CTO Platforms

Job ID: 67406

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and productionise AI safety detectors for enterprise AI applications, including prompt injection and jailbreak detection, personally identifiable information and sensitive data detection, data leakage prevention, content safety and harmful content detection, policy violation checks, system prompt leakage detection, and agent or tool-use risk controls.
  • Build detector pipelines using a multiple approaches, including rule-based detection, pattern matching, NLP / ML classifiers, embedding base models, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators, and hybrid detection strategies with clear interfaces, confidence scoring and policy-driven actions.
  • Develop and optimize detector models and evaluation workflows for guardrails, including test sets creation, data labeling strategies, fine-tuning, model validation, threshold calibration, precision / recall optimization, regression testing, and continuous improvement based on production feedback.
  • Evaluate and integrate industry and open-source AI safety solutions, including detector frameworks, safety models and third-party services; perform build-vs-buy analysis, bechmarking, integration, and production readiness assessment.
  • Design end-to-end AI safety protection patterns across enterprise AI workloads, including RAG system, coding assistants, conversational AI and agent application covering input, retrieval, generation, output, logging and tool execution layers.
  • Build AI Safety observability and governance capabilities, including detector telemetry, tracing, dashboards, evaluation metrics, audit trails, feedback loops and operational controls to monitor safety effectiveness.
  • Partner with AI platform, infrastructure, security and application teams to productionise safety solution, including performance optimization, scalability improvement, detector lifecycle management and reliable rollout strategies.

Requirements

  • Experience developing first-party detectors for AI safety detectors, including prompt injection, jailbreak, personally identifiable information, data leakage, toxicity, policy violation or agent safety detection.
  • Experience building fine-tuning pipelines for safety-oriented large language models or small language models, including dataset curation, labelling strategy, training workflow implementation, evaluation design, and production validation.
  • Experience identifying, evaluating, integrating and productionising third-party or open-source detector solutions, with clear judgement on quality, latency, cost, operational fit and governance requirements.
  • Experience making sound build-versus-buy decisions for detector capabilities, and taking either internally developed or externally sourced solutions through evaluation, integration, rollout and ongoing operation in production.
  • Experience with AI evaluation or observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, Phoenix or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with data loss prevention, secret scanning, document classification or enterprise information protection tooling.
  • Experience with adversarial testing, red teaming or continuous attack simulation for AI systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
